prepare_model_checkpoint: prepare a model checkpoint by stripping optimizer, scheduler, and iteration metadata from a torch save file
convert_model_final_to_base: convert a model_final.pth checkpoint to a base model file by removing training artifacts
load_and_clean_torch_checkpoint: load a torch checkpoint from a base path and clean it by removing non-essential keys
save_pruned_model_checkpoint: save a pruned model checkpoint to an output path after removing optimizer, scheduler, and iteration fields
run_model_base_prepare: run the model_base_prepare script to produce a clean model checkpoint from a training output
